name: 8AN to 7/8 - 14 SAE
title: 8AN to 7/8 - 14 SAE
description:
The 8AN to 7/8 - 14 SAE is engineered for high-demand automotive fluid systems. Whether you’re a professional building a 6-second NHRA bracket car, a perfectionist designing the ultimate engine bay for a SEMA car, or an HPDE enthusiast looking to improve your oil temps, the products are designed for all flavors of motorsports.

ColorFittings products are carefully machined from 6061-T6 Billet Aluminum and finished with the proprietary polish and anodizing process.

Available in unique gloss-finish colors, these AN Fittings are specifically designed for use with high-quality PTFE hose.

AN Hose applications pair excellently with the lightweight Hose Separators, which are available in unique gloss-finish colors.

For a hassle-free installation process, Color-Fittings strongly recommend using the Fitting Assembly Tools.

Technical Specifications:
• Origin: Precision CNC-machined in the USA.
• Material & Finish: 6061-T6 Billet Aluminum with hard anodized protective finish.
